mapper.sql: ID, SUPPLIER_NAME, SUPPLIER_CODE, BLACKLIST_TYPE, REASON, SOURCE, EFFECTIVE_DATE, EXPIRY_DATE, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_TIME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM BLACKLIST_SUPPLIER WHERE IS_ACTIVE = TRUE ORDER BY CREATED_TIME DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE BLACKLIST_SUPPLIER SET SUPPLIER_NAME = #{supplierName}, SUPPLIER_CODE = #{supplierCode}, BLACKLIST_TYPE = #{blacklistType}, REASON = #{reason}, SOURCE = #{source}, EFFECTIVE_DATE = #{effectiveDate}, EXPIRY_DATE = #{expiryDate}, IS_ACTIVE = #{active}, CREATED_BY = #{createdBy}, UPDATED_TIME = #{updatedTime} WHERE ID = #{id}
